aboutHeading: I build brands and the products that carry them — designed as one system, not two.
aboutParagraph: I have a soft spot for the gap between a brand's promise and its product, and I'm relentlessly driven to close it with design that people actually notice.
aboutBioLong: Expand your bio here: how you got into design, the mix of brand and product work you do day to day, and what makes your process distinct. Two or three sentences is plenty — this sits under your photo on the About page.

howIWorkStep2Desc: Identity systems, UI, and prototypes explored together so brand and product never drift apart.
howIWorkStep3Desc: Polished files, a documented system, and a handoff that your team can actually run with.
ctaCardHeading: Ready to bring your vision to reality?

statsHeading: Why choose me as your designer?
statsParagraph: With experience across brand identity and product design, I make sure your business looks right and works right — grounded in strategy, systems, and a seamless experience.
statCaption: Frames and assets designed since [year] — across brand systems, products, and devices.
